But we don't know current gallons. We could convert 10 liters to gallons: 10 liters * 0.264172 = 2.64172 gallons. So we need to fill 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. But maybe we just fill to full capacity ignoring conversion? The function fillFuelTank expects fuelAmount in gallons. So we need to call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount equal to 50 - current gallons. But we only know liters. So we need to convert liters to gallons. Use liter_to_gallon.
